description_en: LLM search. You can use natural language descriptions to perform searches
description_zh: 大模型搜索。用户可以使用自然语言描述进行搜索
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-media-by-multimodal --search-lib-name test-1 --media-type video --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --text Two_pandas_are_fighting. --namespace name-1 --custom-filters intField1_:_gte_:12,_lte_:13_,_strField2_:_cd_,_de_,_strField1_:_abc --utc-create gte_:1761205662998,_lte_:1771205662998 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMediaByMultimodal

parameters.help_en:
The type of the media assets.

Valid values:

image

video (default)
parameters.help_zh:
媒资类型。默认值video。
image：图片。
video：视频
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The content that you want to query. You can describe the content in natural language
parameters.help_zh: 搜索内容。可以是自然语言描述
parameters.name: text
custom_filters

parameters.help_en:
Creation time, in milliseconds UNIX timestamp. gte indicates greater than or equal to, and lte indicates less than or equal to.

Range example: {"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间，毫秒时间戳。gte大于等于，lte小于等于。
范围，如{"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.name: utc_create

MediaList.description_en: The media assets that contain the specified content

items.description_en: The information about the media asset

From.description_en: The start time of the clip

To.description_en: The end time of the clip

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true false
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。取值：true：成功。false：失败

Total.description_en: The total number of data records that meet the specified filter condition
Total.description_zh: 满足搜索条件的媒资信息总条数
